title: Digital Out of Home / Facade Screens
slide_intent: Coordinate differently shaped outdoor placements so a passerby can connect them as one message.
strategic_value: The current and repeated Life Unlimited signature can tie Spectrum’s lifestyle imagery to a high-rise blue identity panel.
demonstration: A 15-second streetside visualization shows a tall blue facade screen, a broad image-led screen at right and a smaller vertical screen at left playing related brand content.
practical_value: Test whether the signature remains recognizable across adjacent formats and viewing angles.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Preserve the low-angle view of the building, surrounding facade, street and people.

content_islands.name: Screen group
content_islands.spec: Coordinate the tall blue identity panel with the wide photographic panel and the smaller portrait placement, retaining the logo and tagline where shown.

ingredient.name: Outdoor identity system
ingredient.role: Connect separate advertising surfaces at a glance.
ingredient.application: Adapt the current, logo and lifestyle photography to each screen’s proportions while maintaining a recognizable shared signature.
ingredient.scope: This 15-second case-study placement visualization. It does not prescribe a fixed screen synchronization rule for every site.
